exposure: Postnatal age of death (1-6 days, 7-28 days, >28 days)
Body temperature at admission to neonatal intensive care
cohort: 5697 very preterm infants (<32 weeks of gestation) admitted for neonatal care from 19 regions in 11 European countries
finding: Admission hypothermia (<35.5°C) after very preterm birth was associated with increased risk of early (1-6 days) and late (7-28 days) neonatal death, but not mortality after 28 days of age.
